in significant downtime.

deployment while maintaining application performance. The DevOps engineer must ensure that
Application versions are configured consistently across all instances and, at the same time,

options.B: Switch to a blue/green deployment strategy for future application updates.
options.C: Switch to an immutable deployment strategy for future application updates.
options.D: Switch to a continuous deployment strategy for future application updates.

explanation:
c.
An immutable deployment would start a whole set of new instances running the new application. This
solution would eliminate downtime and maintain the same application performance. Furthermore, the implementation
of the app update would be consistent across all new instances. The new instances must pass the
health checks before they are used to serve traffic. When the new systems are working and healthy,
delete the original instances.
KEY IDEA: Immutable creates a new, validated fleet before retiring the old one, avoiding mixed versions and loss
of capacity.
WHY NOT THE OTHERS
A. A continuous deployment with an additional batch strategy would deploy new instances and update one or more
instances at a time to replace the current application. This solution would eliminate downtime during an update.
B. A blue/green implementation would violate the company's requirement to avoid creating new environments. This solution
would require creating a new environment in Elastic Beanstalk.
D. A continuous deployment would update one or more instances at a time to replace the current application. This solution
would eliminate downtime during an update.

Use Amazon Inspector rules to detect and notify when an AWS CloudFormation stack has a change of
configuration.
options.B:
Use an AWS Config rule to detect and notify when AWS CloudFormation drift detection identifies

Use AWS CloudTrail to detect and notify when an AWS CloudFormation stack detects a change of
configuration.
options.D:
Use AWS Trusted Advisor to detect and notify when an AWS CloudFormation stack has a change of
